_designSource: LibreChat has NO Storybook for our fork components. UI grounding = reproduce the existing components under client/src/components + packages/client and LibreChat's semantic Tailwind tokens (text-text-*, surface-*, border-*), plus the web knowledge pack. New/changed UI is previewed by running the client (npm run frontend:dev) or a Playwright screenshot of the running app — there is no Storybook preview step.
build: npm run frontend && npm --prefix client run typecheck
